description: Every mitigation named in evals/redteam/threats.yaml maps to a test-only ablation flag (app/security/ablations.ts) or a recorded reason it cannot be ablated at runtime, with the test that proves it (ADR-013, AC-WP10-04).

attribute_allowlist.reason: proven by the WP-01 telemetry canary and AC-WP06-18

boot_guards.reason: proven by AC-WP01 image boot guard tests

bounded_extraction.reason: WP-11 (AC-WP11-02) rejects traversal and decompression bombs

budgets.reason: per-user gateway budgets are a WP-08 follow-up (not implemented); tool loops are bounded by iteration_cap and turn_deadline

command_flagging.reason: client-side rendering policy; proven by AC-WP06-06 browser test

deny_rules.reason: .claude/settings.json deny list; verified by hand, not at runtime

diversity_caps.evidence: discriminates at the retrieval layer: tests/functional/redteam/rank_poison_ablations.spec.ts (AC-WP10-03); the T-08 case is a retrieval case, which runSuite does not replay

encoded_payloads.reason: repository convention enforced by the payload marker scan (AC-WP10-01)

end_of_options.reason: proven by AC-WP03 option-shaped ref tests

exception_scrubbing.reason: proven by AC-WP01 exception policy tests

forward_proxy_allowlist.reason: network topology; proven by AC-WP01 egress tests (containers cannot reach forbidden destinations)

history_sends_answers_and_handles_only.reason: proven by AC-WP06-05 / INV-15 continuation payload test

hold_back_rules.evidence: the gateway's hold-back rules as a whole; the conformance suite (AC-WP08-02) covers the streaming form

immutable_identity_keys.reason: proven by AC-WP02-01 (email change keeps the account; same email different oid separates)

injection_flag.reason: annotation only by design (ADR-033 §6); AC-WP08-11 proves it never changes a decision

job_permission_isolation.reason: proven by AC-WP00-03 workflow checks and zizmor

link_policy.reason: client-side rendering policy; proven by AC-WP06-06 browser test

no_llm_in_decision_path.reason: WP-13: enforced by an import-path CI check (AC-WP13-03)

no_shell.reason: Semgrep rule no-shell-spawn (WP-03) plus git runner using execFile

object_db_reads_no_checkout.reason: ingestion reads git objects only (ADR-019); proven by AC-WP03-01 (no working tree, symlink targets as text)

output_sanitiser.reason: React escaping plus SafeHtml/DOMPurify; browser-enforced. Proven by AC-WP06-07 (XSS canary never executes) and INV-06 lint

prompt_contains_no_secrets.reason: structural: the prompt is a versioned file with no secret material; the canary rule (system_prompt_canary_rule) is the runtime control

prompt_contract.reason: prompt text is not an executable control; the entity verifier and the gate are. Ablate those instead

react_escaping.reason: framework behaviour; proven by AC-WP06-07 XSS canary test

redaction.reason: collector configuration; proven by the WP-01 telemetry canary through the collector

ref_format_validation.reason: proven by AC-WP03 option-shaped ref tests

registry_only_fetch.reason: WP-11 Tier 1 fetch (AC-WP11-02) ignores lockfile resolved

repository_acl.evidence: AC-WP02-05 IDOR matrix with restricted repositories

row_level_security.reason: database policy; cannot be switched at runtime by the app role. Proven by AC-WP02-06 (policies present) and the no_app_scope_checks ablation still denying

scoped_hydration.reason: every hydration joins through the actor scope; proven by AC-WP05-01 and AC-WP06-03

secret_redaction.evidence: AC-WP03-05 (ingest redaction) proves the control; replay cases ablate the gateway secret rules

separate_test_targets.reason: proven by AC-WP01-02 (production image contains no test modules)

session_scoped_tools.evidence: AC-WP02-05 IDOR matrix and the tenancy ablation tests

signed_policy_artefacts.reason: proven by AC-WP08-04 (unsigned or wrongly signed policy refused)

strict_csp.reason: browser-enforced header; proven by AC-WP01 header tests and AC-WP06-07 CSP-violation listener

sufficiency_gate.evidence: discriminates at the retrieval layer: tests/functional/redteam/rank_poison_ablations.spec.ts (AC-WP10-03); the T-08 case is a retrieval case, which runSuite does not replay

summary_verifier.reason: WP-13 deliverable; case frozen with runner test once it exists

tenant_and_issuer_allowlist.reason: proven by AC-WP02-01 (foreign tid and unlisted iss rejected)

unprivileged_parser_process.reason: process isolation (read-only fs, no secrets in env); proven by AC-WP03-01 and the parser child tests

url_and_protocol_policy.reason: proven by AC-WP03-02/03 registration policy tests including redirect chains

workspace_keyed_caches.reason: proven by AC-WP04 (two workspaces share no cache rows)
